title: Robot Bounded In Circle
goal: Decide whether indefinitely repeating the robot program stays bounded.
strategy: After one cycle, return to the origin or face a different direction to remain bounded. A changed heading makes displacement cancel over later cycles.

phasePurposes.start: Decide whether indefinitely repeating the robot program stays bounded.
phasePurposes.inspect: After one cycle, return to the origin or face a different direction to remain bounded. A changed heading makes displacement cancel over later cycles.
phasePurposes.update: After one cycle, return to the origin or face a different direction to remain bounded. A changed heading makes displacement cancel over later cycles.
phasePurposes.done: Decide whether indefinitely repeating the robot program stays bounded.

edgeCases: Returns to origin facing the original direction
Turns without moving stay at the origin
